purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record routes, bounded anonymous access review, scope limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official Smart Bhumi Naksha page exposes a public map UI and its current JavaScript/configuration identifies POST routes /getAdminByCode and /getGeomByCode, with GeoServer WMS layers. The anonymous division response returned seven divisions; the Khulna district response returned only Bagerhat and Khulna, not Kushtia. The official settlement map search loaded as an admin-login panel. No anonymous Kushtia parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or native parcel ID was obtained.
registryAssessment: National custodian evidence: Department of Land Records and Surveys/Ministry of Land. Local evidence: Kushtia district land-service pages and a Kushtia project office. No current public Kushtia-specific cadastral registry/map endpoint was proven; registryFound is null.
